finding: Untrained Qwen2.5-1.5B does not emit parseable tool calls for Deal Rescue (the hardest scenario). All 4 reward functions stay at 0 across training. Completions are clipped at 256 tokens (clipped_ratio=1), indicating the model never terminates a proper tool-call structure. Full training would require either SFT warmup or curriculum learning (starting with the morning_checkin scenario, then ramping up).
